VERATRUM  ALBUWI.

White  Hellebore.  Melanthacese.

The  European  Hellebore  grows  in  moist  meadows  in  the  Alps  and  Pyrenees,
through  Russia,  Northern  China  and  Japan.

The  tincture  is  prepared  from  the  powdered  dry  root.

p.  73;   Schelliug,  A.  H.  Z.,  vol.  83,  p.  19.
